J19.falha_pt: Trata o agro como um bloco único: o veganismo se opõe à criação e à morte de animais, e não à agricultura, de onde vem a comida vegana

formas: You want to put farmers out of business
Without farmers, you wouldn't even have your salad
Vegans bite the hand that feeds them
en.falha: Treats farming as a single block: veganism opposes breeding and killing animals, not crop growing, which is where vegan food comes from

J20.falha_pt: Pertencer não exige comer o mesmo prato, e o desconforto social de quem recusa não se compara ao custo para o animal

en.frase: I don't want to feel left out; eating together is how you belong
formas: I feel socially out of place
I want to belong, and eating is one of the things the group does
I don't want to be the odd one out at the table
en.falha: Belonging doesn't require eating the same dish, and the social discomfort of refusing doesn't compare with the cost to the animal

J21.falha_pt: Falácia genética: uma posição moral não fica falsa porque alguém lucra com ela, e o negócio de explorar animais é muito maior

formas: It's just marketing to sell expensive products
Veganism is a market niche for people with money
The same meat companies sell the vegan burger
en.falha: Genetic fallacy: a moral position doesn't become false because someone profits from it, and the business of exploiting animals is far bigger

J22.falha_pt: O dado da FAO fala de 20% da proteína animal, e não das necessidades de proteína, e a dependência de alguns não justifica o consumo de quem tem escolha

en.frase: Billions of people depend on fish for protein
formas: 3.2 billion people get 20% of their protein from fish
The least we can do is guarantee a quick, painless slaughter
en.falha: The FAO figure refers to 20% of animal protein, not of protein needs, and the dependence of some doesn't justify consumption by those who have a choice

M13.falha_pt: Espécies e biodiversidade não sentem: o sencientista apoia a preservação quando ela é boa para os indivíduos e só a questiona quando os prejudica

en.frase: Sentientists are against preserving species and biodiversity
formas: Sentientists are in favor of biodiversity loss
You don't care whether a species goes extinct
en.falha: Species and biodiversity don't feel: the sentientist supports preservation when it is good for individuals and questions it only when it harms them

M14.falha_pt: Espantalho: as propostas reais são pesquisa, ajuda pontual e cautela, e reconhecer que há sofrimento num lugar não é propor destruí-lo

en.frase: Sentientists want to get rid of forests
formas: You want to pave over nature to end suffering
The only way to end predation is to destroy ecosystems
en.falha: Straw man: the real proposals are research, targeted help and caution, and recognizing that there is suffering in a place isn't proposing to destroy it
